persona: Composed and precise. Worried that the other driver has no insurance. Has two photos and the quote.
initial_message: Hello, I was rear-ended at the traffic lights at the end of the Wharf Test Street off-ramp in Ellerslie, Auckland, on Wednesday 2 September at about 5:40pm. The other driver admitted it was his fault, but he told me he does not have insurance. Nobody was hurt and my car can still be driven. The rear bumper and the tailgate are damaged.

design.notes: The other driver admitted fault but has no insurance, so any recovery from him is uncertain.

triage.rationale: The other driver admitted fault at the scene but is uninsured. Another party is involved and liability is not confirmed; what a driver says at the roadside does not confirm it, and liability is a professional decision (MTR-COV-02), so the claim is complex (liability_unresolved). The quote total is $6,129.50 including GST, over NZD 5,000 (amount_over_threshold_or_unknown). Photos and a complete quote are supplied. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (15 January 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2022-01-15, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
